Product:{\"sku\":\"7100140921\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Welcome to Astralis: Dawnblades!

Take command of the Dawnblades, an independent mercenary company, and embark on an epic adventure through a world of ancient magic, rival kingdoms, and forgotten legends.

Build Your Company

Recruit heroes, develop their classes and specializations, and create powerful squads. Customize your characters with weapons, armor, and unique abilities to overcome increasingly dangerous challenges.

Explore Dangerous Dungeons

Venture into dungeons filled with enemies, treasures, unexpected events, and difficult decisions. Choose your path carefully, manage your resources, and decide whether to push deeper for greater rewards or retreat to safety.

Develop Your Stronghold

Between expeditions, return to your headquarters to strengthen your company. Upgrade your facilities, manage your equipment, craft powerful items, and prepare your squads for their next adventure.

Master Turn-Based Combat

Face challenging enemies in strategic turn-based battles. Combine abilities, exploit enemy weaknesses, and discover powerful synergies between your characters.

Looking for an additional challenge? Activate the optional Musical Active Time Battle (MATB) system to introduce musical timing and new combat possibilities.

Shape Your Adventure

Experience a rich fantasy campaign spanning three acts, filled with memorable characters, mysterious lands, and meaningful choices.

Experiment with different classes, equipment, squad compositions, and strategies. With numerous possibilities and replayable adventures, every journey offers new challenges.

The Dawnblades are waiting for your command. What kind of legend will you create?
